pages.text: $(l)Chapter 1, the Overworld$(): the Amethyst Crab, then the Wildlands bosses (Ancient Remnant, Maledictus, the Leviathan), then $(l)The Harbinger$() in the Frontier.$(br2)$(l)Chapter 2, the Nether$(): the Netherite Monstrosity, then $(l)Ignis$().
$(l)Chapter 3, the End$(): the Ender Dragon and the $(l)Ender Guardian$(). The Wither is an optional group raid.$(br2)Optional Overworld bosses: the Ferrous Wroughtnaut, the Frostmaw and Umvuthi.
